item.title: EOS Maintenance
item.description:
Nov 10, 07:30 UTC
Completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

Nov 10, 06:00 UTC
In progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

Oct 13, 18:29 UTC
Scheduled - Epic Online Services is scheduled for maintenance on Tuesday 10 November 2026, 6 am UTC. During the maintenance window, there will be degraded availability for up to 90 minutes for the following services:
- Sessions
- Lobbies

During this window, existing player sessions will time out and clients will be disconnected. New session creation, invites, searching, and matchmaking will also be temporarily unavailable during that time. We expect (our built-in) retry functionality to limit the impact of this disruption, but session/lobby invites may fail.
